programs.title: La grazia
programs.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programs.title: Eddie the Eagle
programs.desc: British ski jumper Michael 'Eddie' Edwards, although not successful, believes in his abilities.Thanks to the help of a charismatic coach, in 1988 he took part in the Olympics in Calgary.

programs.title: Ghostlight
programs.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.

programs.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
programs.desc: Bella Swan and Edward Cullen are getting married.They spend their honeymoon on a private island in Brazil belonging to the groom's family.Two weeks later, Bella discovers she is pregnant.The fetus is developing at a rapid pace.The couple returns to Forks.It turns out that Bella's condition means great danger to her.The werewolves, led by Sam, want to kill her unborn offspring, who may turn out to be a demon.Jacob defies his pack and decides to protect his lost loved one.The Cullen family prepares for a difficult birth.Edward will have to fight to save the person he loves with all his heart.

programs.title: Ford v Ferrari
programs.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programs.title: The Front Runner
programs.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programs.title: The Greatest Showman
programs.desc: P. T. Barnum (Ellis Rubin) is the son of a tailor who works for the Hallett family.The boy falls in love with his employers' daughter, Charity (Skylar Dunn).They stay in touch for many years, and when they are adults, they get married.One day, Phineas (Hugh Jackman) loses his job.Wanting to ensure the happiness of his wife (Michelle Williams) and two daughters, a man opens a wax museum.When the idea turns out to be unsuccessful, he decides to show visitors live exhibits.He employs outstanding people - including: the acrobat Anne (Zendaya) and her brother W. D. (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), the woman with the beard Lettie Lutz (Keala Settle) and Charles Stratton (Sam Humphrey).The show attracts a large audience but receives negative reviews;Barnum's museum is called a circus.To improve his reputation, the man invites Phillip Carlyle (Zac Efron) to cooperate with him.He soon meets Swedish singer Jenny Lind (Rebecca Ferguson).The artist's performance turns out to be a breakthrough for his career.

programs.title: Cash For Gold
programs.desc: American province.After the death of her soldier husband in Afghanistan, Grace (Deborah Puette), a single mother, loses herself in alcohol addiction.The widow, in order to provide a decent life for her son (Sawyer Gacka) and protect their house from being taken over by the bank, decides to fight for a change of fate.He joins an AA group and takes a job in a pawn shop owned by the only Muslim family in town.Over time, her friendly relationship with the owners of the plant, Mohammad (Marcelo Tubert) and his son, Hasan (Farshad Farahat), becomes less and less popular with the local community.

programs.title: Silent Trees
programs.desc: Runa, a sixteen-year-old Kurdish girl, flees Iraq with her family from ISIS attacks.Over time, he reaches the Polish-Belarusian border and then to Poland, where he and his relatives receive asylum.Unfortunately, the price the family pays for getting to Europe is high.Runa's mother, being in an advanced stage of pregnancy, dies in the hospital due to exhaustion caused by her stay in the border forest.Now Runa has to grow up at an accelerated pace - she becomes the head of the family, because she has to take care of not only her four younger brothers, but also her father, who cannot cope with the growing difficulties.

programs.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programs.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programs.title: Apolonia, Apolonia
programs.desc: A painting made over several years, which shows the personal and artistic development of Apolonia Sokol, a young generation painter with Polish roots.Her works have been shown in France and the USA.

programs.title: Macbeth
programs.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.
